resources.string: Automatic tasks require this account to be connected, the app in the foreground and the screen on. Online random mode waits 15–90 seconds during the selected daily window, then attempts one message per day. If you leave before it runs, it retries a random wait when you return within the window. Fixed-time mode skips missed times. A manual send counts as today’s run; repeated manual sends are allowed. Check the chat for delivery and bot check-in results.
Choose a group or bot, a message (such as /checkin), and an online random window or fixed daily time. Tasks belong to this account on this device.
Send the following message to %1$s now? This also counts as today’s run. Repeated manual sends will send the message again.\n\n%2$s
Added to the send queue; check the chat for delivery
Choose a group you can write to or a bot. Deleted chats and channels are not supported.
This chat requires paid messages. Send from the chat manually.
Could not save this task. No new message was queued.

Telegram does not allow clients to set an arbitrary last-seen date or time. These controls temporarily request online/offline status while this app is running. Visibility depends on Telegram privacy rules and other logged-in devices; activity may still reveal that you are online.

Choose a duration from 1 to 60 minutes. The online option temporarily overrides Hide online status and requires the app to be active. At the end, your normal privacy settings apply again. Temporary presence is cleared when the app restarts.
Enter a duration from 1 to 60 minutes.

Sends a real temporary activity indicator to the selected chat every few seconds. No message, recording or sticker is created. Stops when the duration ends, you leave the app, the screen turns off, or Hide typing status is enabled. Telegram decides whether recipients see the indicator.
Choose a writable chat, connect this account and turn off Hide typing status first.
